question: When should the practitioner behold the personified sin-man again?
premises: The object of vision is the personified sin-man.
The time specified is the end of recitation.
The act of beholding is to be repeated.
inference: At the end of recitation, one should again behold the sin-man.
plain_english: At the end of the recitation, one should again behold the sin-man.
